storage: Remove the stems, keep in a paper-lined box or bag in the fridge for about a week; do not wash until use.
looksLike: A slim, 5 to 10 cm green pod, glossy, pointed at the tip. BigBasket sells long medium, small and dark green types; heat varies a lot.
howToPick: Bright glossy green, firm, with the stem attached and no wrinkles or black spots. Avoid soft, slimy or yellowing pods.
shelfLife: About a week in the fridge (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Green chilli paste or slit pods from the pantry (frozen)
Green capsicum plus a pinch of pepper

usedIn.raw: 3 g per serving (½ small chilli, finely chopped)
3 g per serving (1 small, half in chutney and half chopped)
